# SYPHILIS

# Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases. Evaluation and management are complex.

Syphilis is a sexually transmitted disease caused by the spirochete Treponema pallidum that can manifest as a variety of signs or symptoms. Primary syphilis typically consists of painless ulcers or chancre at the site of infection with regional adenopathy. Secondary syphilis often includes a skin rash (disseminated and/or including the palms and soles), fever, malaise, mucocutaneous lesions and lymphadenopathy. Tertiary syphilis includes those with cardiovascular or gummatous disease.

Latent syphilis is a period of disease when a patient does not have symptoms but is found to be infected through serologic testing. Early latent syphilis refers to latent syphilis acquired within the preceding year and late latent syphilis refers to all other cases of latent syphilis. Neurosyphilis, Ocular syphilis or Otosyphilis, can occur at any stage of syphilis with early manifestations (e.g. meningitis, stroke, vision or hearing loss) occurring within the first months to years of infection and late manifestations (e.g. dementia, tabes dorsalis) occurring after 10-30 years.

# Diagnosis

A presumptive diagnosis is made through use of a nontreponemal or serologic test (i.e. rapid plasma reagin [RPR]) and a treponemal test (i.e. fluorescent treponemal antibody absorbed [FTA-ABS]). Direct methods through darkfield microscopy and direct fluorescent antibody (DFA) must be used for definitive diagnosis since T. pallidum cannot be cultured.

[Syphilis antibody test with reflex to rapid plasma reagin (RPR)](lrtz-syphilis-ab-w-reflex-to-rpr-w-titer)

# Management of sex partners

Persons with sexual contact with a person with primary, secondary or early latent syphilis within the last 90 days should be presumptively treated even if serologic test is negative.

# Neurosyphilis, Ocular syphilis or Otosyphilis

Consult Infectious Disease for treatment

## Primary, Secondary and Early Latent Syphilis

Preferred:
[Benzathine Penicillin 2.4 million units IM once ($$$) M](psjzid-benzathine-penicillin-2-4mu-im-once)

Secondary (for patients who are not pregnant):
[Beta-lactam Reaction Assessment](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
[Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h ($) DI for 14 days](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)

## Tertiary and Late Latent Syphilis

Preferred:
[Benzathine Penicillin 2.4 million units IM qweek ($$$) M x3 doses](psjzid2-benzathine-penicillin-2-4mu-im-qweek-x3-syphilis)

Secondary (for patients who are not pregnant):
[Beta-lactam Reaction Assessment](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
